item.title: Gold Coast’s Trump Tower will become Australia’s tallest building

item.title: New hotel growth slows and shifts outside CBD reshaping Australia’s pipeline: Colliers
item.description: Australia’s hotel development cycle is entering a more “constrained and selective phase” amid rising build costs, with a considerable shift toward outside core CBD hotel markets, the latest Colliers report states. The post New hotel growth slows and shifts outside CBD reshaping Australia’s pipeline: Colliers appeared first on Hotel Management.
